Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

letsR 6.1.0

New features

  • Added lets.range(), a new function for estimating species geographic ranges from occurrence records using DBSCAN spatial clustering and buffered concave hulls.
  • The new function supports multiple spatial clusters per species, isolated occurrence records, flexible buffering distances, and geographic masking through intersection or exclusion.
  • Added support for handling complex range geometries, including multipart polygons and ranges crossing the antimeridian.

Improvements

  • Improved geographic range estimation workflows by integrating occurrence-based range reconstruction with existing letsR functions.
  • Added compatibility checks for GEOS versions required for concave hull construction.
  • Improved the documentation of lets.correl(), clarifying distance classes, statistical inference, and interpretation of Moran’s I correlograms.

Documentation

  • Added a vignette demonstrating lets.range(), including spatial clustering, geographic masking, and integration with lets.presab().
  • Added a methodological comparison of geographic range estimation using lets.range(), alphahull, and rangeBuilder.
  • Added a vignette demonstrating lets.correl() using climatic data and exploring autocorrelation across geographic, environmental, and phylogenetic distance matrices.
  • Expanded the discussion of the differences between occurrence-based range estimates and IUCN geographic range mapping approaches.

Dependencies and compatibility

  • Added dbscan to package imports.
  • Updated the minimum required version of sf to 1.0-11.
  • Documented the requirement for GEOS 3.11.0 or later for concave hull construction.

Citation

  • Updated the package citation to include Vilela et al. (2026), alongside the original letsR publication by Vilela and Villalobos (2015).

letsR 6.0.0

New features

  • Added functions for mapping biodiversity across geographic, environmental, and attribute spaces.
  • Added new vignettes describing environmental-space and attribute-space analyses.

Documentation

  • Reorganized the package documentation to improve accessibility.
  • Added an annotated documentation index to the README.

Improvements

  • Updated functions to use current terra and sf workflows.
  • Improved plotting and summary methods for PresenceAbsence objects.
